frozen_before: every textspot6 training run and every score of a textspot6 arm (no run, probe or score exists: the 60-step trainer smoke on 2 titles and the harness checks on textspot3's released pick are not arms)

spotter.format: VTSP version 4 (synth/textspot6_twin.py): textspot3's T trunk (VTDT) or M network (VTMS) with a 16 + 4 T channel d2s head; T = 4 tag maps
spotter.runtime: runtime/vocr_textspot6.c (pinned by an amendment before any score: C == twin on every development frame is an eligibility condition)

budget.time: the A9 cycle model's high bound x 1.0007 at 333 MHz on runtime/vocr_textspot6.c for the shape and scale (textspot3's method), plus 1.4 ms per refined horizontal box at the arm's median on the development Vita frames for det+refine; reported at 444 MHz too
budget.owner: weights <= 500 KB (2026-10-26); time within textspot3's budget unless a bigger one clearly pays (the trade reported)

data.hook: vocr6-ingest's page pool v1 + splits_v1.json through synth/textspot6_pages.py (rules in its RULES; the shard manifest data/manifests/textspot6_pages_v1.json is pinned by an amendment before any run)

recipes.base: 30,000 steps x 16 windows of 256 x 512 at the network's scale, AdamW 4e-3, 500 warm-up, cosine to 1e-4, clip 5, EMA 0.999 from step 1,000, QAT from 80% (EMA swap, BN re-estimation 32 batches, #97's calibration 32 batches), the QAT average is the run's model; loss = textspot2_train.loss_of + 1.0 x tag loss; augmentation as train/textspot6_train.AUG
recipes.kd: base + textspot2_train.kd_loss on K, O, A from the teacher + 1.0 x KL(teacher || student) of the tag softmax on cells where sigmoid(K_t) > 0.5

1.shape: registered by an amendment with its A9 row, before its runs

2.rule: kd_t64n8c16 distilled from the stage-1 M arm (base_qS4 or base_qL5) with the lower unseen-dev page-path dialogue CER (its representative's det or det+refine, whichever is lower; ties: the smaller shape); the teacher is that representative seed's final.pt

seeds.representative: per decode, the median seed by unseen-dev page-path dialogue CER (sorted by that CER, then hval page-path CER, then seed; index n // 2: with 2 seeds the worse one); never the best seed
seeds.crashes: restart from scratch with the same seed, at most 3 attempts

metrics.primary: page-path dialogue CER through eval/pagepath.py (#129; pinned by an amendment before any score): Rubi's read (VOCR5-N W8I top 8, counter re-decode, beam 8 + the 1 MB LM, cascade N -> L below 0.7, textnorm, the non-Japanese line filter)
metrics.unseen_dev: #119's 1,161 whole-dialogue units ($A/vocr5-analysis/work/units.pkl, console view); the headline leaves the units of v12188 (seen: hooked title PCSG00576) out; the full set reported
metrics.hval: the page pool's dialogue regions of the hval pages (base / +4 / +8), console view (PSP at 2x)
metrics.spotter_boxes: eval/textspot6.py spot (the whole frame) -> pagepath-boxes: each unit reads the horizontal boxes whose centre lies in its region; decodes det and det+refine
metrics.baseline: GRAD + refine: eval/pagepath.py --finder rubi on the unit's region
metrics.intervals: paired; 10,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples, seed 0: VN clusters (dev), title clusters (hval)
report_only: tsdev: textspot's whole-frame metrics on its 188 dev frames + the tagged dialogue CER + presence on the 25 text-free frames (eval/textspot6.py tsdev; the harness reproduces textspot3's record of its pick exactly, both decodes)
hval boxes: P / R / F1 vs the verified lines, recall per class, tag accuracy, per view and title
textspot3's pick (v0.3.4-textspot3.1) through the same paths

rule.eligible: VTSP bytes <= 512,000, est. ms @333 <= 300, arena <= 262,144, C == twin on every development frame
rule.beats_grad_refine: unseen dev: page-path dialogue CER difference (candidate - GRAD + refine) with a 95% interval entirely below 0; hval: the difference not resolved above 0
rule.cost_order: VTSP bytes, est. ms @333, arena, det before det+refine, then the name
rule.pick: the cheapest qualifier; a costlier qualifier replaces it when, against it, unseen-dev page-path CER is resolved below 0 and hval is not resolved above 0; repeated until none does
rule.no_qualifier: negative verdict; the eligible candidate with the lowest unseen-dev page-path CER is released as a research pre-release; no Rubi PR
rule.with_pick: retrain the pick on train + guard + hval (same recipe and seed) -> release, test sets once, Rubi DRAFT PR (never merged by the fleet)

sets: the test title(s) through the page path (Dance with Devils page-pool units)
CLANNAD whole frames (the frozen long-run references, textspot3's way)
test.paired_against: GRAD + refine and textspot3's pick, read the same way

estimates: console times are A9 cycle-model estimates; nothing runs on a console (hardware work is paused)
disclosures: hval is seen titles (blocks of training titles)
one dev VN is seen (v12188, hooked PCSG00576); the headline leaves it out
the dev regions were drawn by people: the region-assisted page path gives the spotter GRAD + refine's region; the whole-frame tagged path is reported beside it
sources_note: the trainer, model, twin, shapes and page builder as frozen; eval/textspot6.py and eval/pagepath.py are pinned by the amendment that precedes the first score; docs/textspot6.md's protocol section is frozen by its own rule (changes only through dated amendments)
